title: Retrieving planktonic foraminifera from lithified rocks
author: Ištuk, Kampić, et al.
materials: No differences in preservation of tests among representatives of thermocline foraminifera genera were observed.

steps.title: Crush rock samples
steps.instruction: Break 100 g of limestone (repeat twice) and 100 g of marl into fragments no larger than 5 mm.

steps.title: Divide into subsamples
steps.instruction: Portion each crushed sample into five subsamples of 20 g each and place each subsample in a separate glass beaker.

steps.title: Prepare reaction solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare four acetic‑acid–water mixtures: 50 % CH₃COOH + 50 % deionized water, 60 % + 40 %, 70 % + 30 %, 80 % + 20 %; also prepare a water‑hydrogen‑peroxide mixture using 30 % H₂O₂. Adjust the liquid level so it is about 2 cm above the sample in each beaker.

steps.title: Add solutions to subsamples
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate acetic‑acid solution to four subsamples and add the H₂O₂‑water mixture to the fifth subsample.

steps.title: Incubate reactions
steps.instruction: Let the acetic‑acid subsamples react at room temperature for either 5 h or 15 h (two sets of subsamples); let the peroxide‑treated subsample react for 24 h. Note the formation of calcium acetate crystals during acid treatments.

steps.title: Wash and sieve residues
steps.instruction: After incubation, pour each beaker through a stack of steel sieves with mesh openings of 1.00 mm, 0.500 mm, 0.250 mm, 0.125 mm and 0.063 mm, rinsing thoroughly with deionized water. Collect the material retained on each sieve.

steps.title: Dry residues
steps.instruction: Spread the retained material from each sieve on clean trays and dry at ambient temperature for 24 h.

steps.title: Weigh and label residues
steps.instruction: Weigh the dried residue from each sieve, record the masses, and transfer the material into clearly labeled paper bags.

steps.title: Select foraminiferal tests
steps.instruction: Perform a dry sieve over the 0.063 mm mesh, then randomly pick approximately 100 foraminiferal tests per sample using a microsplitter; examine the selected tests under an Olympus SZX7 stereomicroscope (or Olympus U‑TV‑1XC camera) to assess preservation categories.

steps.title: Optional SEM imaging
steps.instruction: Acquire scanning electron microscope images of selected specimens for publication purposes.
